author: Jelou Inc. (https://jelou.ai)

release_notes.headline: `jelou pull` reports upstream-deleted workflows; `jelou push` fixes stale JelouPay payment versions.

highlights.text: `jelou pull` now tells you when workflows were deleted on the server instead of silently dropping them — the removed ones are named in the summary (and in `data.removed` for `--json` / `--agent`), so you can see which local files are now orphaned. `jelou pull --check` previews the same under `wouldRemove`.

`jelou push` now stamps JelouPay payment nodes with the payment tool's current live version instead of a `1.0.0` placeholder, so the node no longer renders against a stale or wrong version. Other native tools (e.g. KYC) are unaffected.
